title: North-West Frontier Province Forestry Commission Amendment Act 2005

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Forestry Commission Amendment Act 2005
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIV OF 2005
ACT XIV OF 2005
North-West
Frontier Province Forestry Commission (Amendment) Act 2005
An Act to
amend the North-West Frontier
Province Forestry Commission
Act, 1999
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary,
15th November, 2005]
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province Forestry Commission
(Amendment) Act, 2005.
(2)
It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Forestry Commission Amendment Act 2005
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 of N.-W.F.P. Act No. XV of 1999

ACT XIV OF 2005
ACT XIV OF 2005
North-West
Frontier Province Forestry Commission (Amendment) Act 2005
An Act to
amend the North-West Frontier
Province Forestry Commission
Act, 1999
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary,
15th November, 2005]
2. Amendment of section 2 of N.-W.F.P.
Act No. XV of 1999.----In the
North-West Frontier Province Forestry Commission Act, 1999 (N.-W.F. P. Act
No.XV of 1999), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 2,--‑
(i) after clause (i), the following new .clause shall
be inserted, namely:
"(ia) "Chairperson" means the Chairperson of the Commission;
";
(ii) for existing clause (iv), the following shall be
substituted, namely:
"(iv) "Department" means the
Environment Department of Government; ";
(iii) in clause (v) for the word
"interring", the word "interacting" shall be substituted;
(iv) in clause (xi), for the word "Chairman",
the word "Chairperson" shall be substituted;
(v) after clause (xi), the following new clause shall
be inserted, namely:
"(xia) "Minister"
means the Minister-in-Charge of Department:"; and
(vi) for the existing clause (xiv), the following shall
be substituted, namely:
"(xiv) "Secretary" means the
Secretary to Government, Environment Department;".

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Forestry Commission Amendment Act 2005
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of N.-W.F.P. Act No.XV of 1999

ACT XIV OF 2005
ACT XIV OF 2005
North-West

An Act to
amend the North-West Frontier
Province Forestry Commission
Act, 1999
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary,
15th November, 2005]
3. Amendment of section 3 of N.-W.F.P.
Act No.XV of 1999.---in the said
Act, in section 3,--‑
(i) for subsection (2), the following shall be
substituted, namely:
"(2) The Commission shall comprise four non-official
members and the following ex-officio
members:
(a)
Minister;
(b)
Chief Secretary to Government;
(c)
Additional Chief Secretary to Government;
(d)
Secretary to Government, Finance Department;
(e)
Secretary to Government, Environment
Department;
(f) Chief Conservator of Forests, North-West Frontier Province.";
(ii) in
subsection (3), before the word "member", the word
"non-official" and after the word "renewable", the word
"natural" shall be inserted;
(iii) in
subsection (4), before the word "members"> the word
"non-official" shall be inserted; and
(iv) after subsection
(4), as so amended, the following new subsections shall be added, namely:
"(5) Minister shall be the
Chairperson of Commission.
(6) The Chief Conservator of
Forests, North-West Frontier Province shall be
Member-cum-Secretary of Commission."

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Forestry Commission Amendment Act 2005
sections.description:
Substitution of section 8 of N.-W.F.P. Act No.XV of 1999

ACT XIV OF 2005
ACT XIV OF 2005
North-West
Frontier Province Forestry Commission (Amendment) Act 2005
An Act to
amend the North-West Frontier
Province Forestry Commission
Act, 1999
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary,
15th November, 2005]
5. Substitution of section 8 of N.-W.F.P. Act No.XV
of 1999.---In
the said Act, for section 8, the following shall be substituted namely:
"8. Term
of office of the non-official members.---(1) The
term of office of each non-official member shall be three years and shall not
be renewable.
(2) Anon-official member may
resign his office by tendering resignation to the Chief Minister.
(3) A non-official member shall
ordinarily hold office uninterrupted for his entire term, unless removed
earlier by the Chief Minister on the charge of an .offence involving moral
turpitude or conviction in any criminal case.
(4) The non-official members and
employees of the Commission shall be eligible to such emoluments and other
benefits as government may determine. "
